sn20.6:1.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave cattāro daḷhadhammā dhanuggahā sikkhitā katahatthā katupāsanā catuddisā ṭhitā assu || || 3
sn20.6:1.4: Ahaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ daḷhadhammānaṃ dhanuggahānaṃ sikkhitānaṃ katahatthānaṃ katupāsanānaṃ catuddisā kaṇḍe khitte appatiṭṭhite pathaviyaṃ gahetvā āharissāmīti || || 4
sn20.6:1.6: javano puriso paramena javena samannāgato ti alam vacanāyā ti || || 5
sn20.6:2.1: Ekassa ce pi bhante daḷhadhammassa dhanuggahassa sikkhitassa katahatthassa katupāsanassa kaṇḍaṃ khittam appatiṭṭhitaṃ pathaviyaṃ gahetvā āhareyya ||
sn20.6:2.2: javano puriso paramena javena samannāgato ti alaṃ vacanāya || || Ko pana vādo catunnaṃ daḷhadhammānam dhanuggahānaṃ sikkhitānaṃ katahatthānaṃ katupāsanānanti || || 6
sn20.6:3.1: Yathā ca bhikkhave tassa purisassa javo || yathā ca candimasūriyānaṃ javo tato sīghataro || ||
sn20.6:3.2: yathā ca bhikkhave tassa purisassa javo yathā ca candimasuriyānaṃ javo yathā ca yā devatā candimasuriyānam purato dhāvanti tāsaṃ devatānaṃ javo || tato sīghataraṃ āyusaṅkhārā khīyanti || 7
